🇨🇭 Swiss quantum spinout ZuriQ lands $25.5M seed

@ZuriQ, an @ETH Zurich spinout, has raised a $25.5M seed round, one of the largest seed tickets in Swiss quantum computing. The company is building trapped-ion quantum processors, an architecture prized for qubit quality and now facing the harder question of scale.

Why it matters:
⚛️ Trapped ions offer the cleanest qubits available today
💰 $25.5M at seed signals conviction, not experimentation
🇨🇭 @ETH Zurich keeps producing globally competitive quantum teams

Quantum hardware is capital hungry, and Switzerland is proving it can fund the early rounds at credible size.

https://sifted.eu/articles/eth-spinout-zuriq-seed-round

🇨🇭 Swiss biotech raises CHF 2.4M for gene editing

@Immitra Bio has closed a CHF 2.4 million round to advance its in-vivo gene editing platform, targeting edits delivered directly inside the body rather than in a lab dish. The financing funds platform development toward preclinical validation.

Why it matters:
🧬 In-vivo editing removes the cost of cell manufacturing
🔬 CHF 2.4M buys real progress in Swiss biotech
🇨🇭 Switzerland's life science density shortens the path to data

Small rounds go further in a country where the science is already world class.

https://www.venturelab.swiss/Immitra-Bio-raises-CHF-24-million-to-advance-invivo-gene-editing-platform

🇨🇭 Swiss space firm raises $70M to build satellites

@SWISSto12 has raised USD 70 million to scale its satellite business as demand grows across multiple orbits. The Renens-based company built its reputation on 3D-printed radio frequency payloads, then moved up the value chain to full geostationary satellites.

Why it matters:
🛰️ Additive manufacturing cuts satellite mass and lead times
🌍 Multi-orbit demand is outpacing incumbent capacity
🇨🇭 A Swiss firm selling complete satellites, not just parts

Moving from component supplier to prime contractor is the rarest jump in European space.

https://ggba.swiss/en/swissto12-raises-usd-70-million-to-meet-growing-multi-orbit-satellite-demand/

🇨🇭 Swiss neutrality becomes a model for AI compute

@SkyPilot, founded by a @Databricks cofounder, has raised $20M to let companies run AI workloads across any cloud or GPU provider. Its pitch: be the Switzerland of AI compute, neutral infrastructure in a market where lock-in is the default.

Why it matters:
☁️ GPU scarcity makes provider neutrality commercially valuable
🔓 Portability is becoming a board-level AI requirement
🇨🇭 Swiss neutrality now reads as an engineering standard

When a Silicon Valley company borrows Switzerland's name to explain its product, the brand is doing real work.

https://fortune.com/2026/07/21/skypilot-from-databricks-cofounder-raises-20m-to-be-the-switzerland-of-ai-compute/

🇨🇭 Swiss software prices designs before they are locked

@valuemize, based in Zurich, has closed a seven-figure pre-seed round backed by a consortium of VC offices and angel investors. Its software shows manufacturers what a design decision will cost while the design is still changeable, when most of the cost is actually set.

Why it matters:
⚙️ Up to 80% of product cost is fixed at design stage
📉 Cost visibility early beats procurement savings later
🇨🇭 Built next to Switzerland's precision manufacturing base

The best industrial software comes from countries that still make things.

https://www.startupticker.ch/en/news/valuemize-raises-seven-figure-pre-seed-for-product-cost-software

🇨🇭 Swiss preventive health platform raises $10M

@Ahead Health has raised $10 million to launch in Germany and the Netherlands. The Swiss startup sells preventive care, deep diagnostics and follow-up rather than reactive treatment, a model that scales only where reimbursement and consumer willingness to pay both exist.

Why it matters:
🩺 Preventive care shifts spending from treatment to detection
🇩🇪 Germany and the Netherlands are the logical first steps
🇨🇭 Swiss health standards travel well across European markets

Switzerland's small home market forces companies to design for export from day one.

https://techfundingnews.com/ahead-health-10m-funding-preventive-care-germany-netherlands/

🇨🇭 Swiss scale-up Hilo adds $19M for US push

@Hilo has closed a Series B extension of $19 million, taking total funding past $119 million. New money comes from @Dell Family Office, the investment office of Michael Dell, alongside existing backers, as the company sets up its expansion into the United States.

Why it matters:
💵 $119M raised to date puts Hilo in Swiss scale-up territory
🌐 US entry is where European valuations get tested
🇨🇭 American family offices are shopping in Switzerland

Swiss companies no longer need to relocate to attract top-tier American capital.

https://www.startupticker.ch/en/news/hilo-closes-series-b-extension-round-to-fuel-us-expansion
